mapper.select: SELECT HE.PERSON_ID, HE.EMPID, HE.LOCAL_NAME, HE.DUTY_NO, GET_DEPT_NAME(HE.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(GET_AR_SHIFTNO(HE.PERSON_ID, REPLACE(#{applyDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-', '/'), HE.CPNY_ID), #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) SHIFT_NO_NAME, AR_GET_VAC_FOR_ESS(#{applyDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HE.PERSON_ID, '0') + AR_GET_VAC_FOR_ESS(#{applyDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HE.PERSON_ID, '4') + AR_GET_VAC_FOR_ESS(#{applyDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HE.PERSON_ID, 'LAST_YEAR_VAC') TOT_VAC_CNT, AR_GET_VAC_FOR_ESS(#{applyDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HE.PERSON_ID, '3') SHENGYU_VAC_CNT, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(HE.PERSON_ID, REPLACE(#{applyDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '-', '/')) DAY_HOURS, HPI.SEXCODE FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HE LEFT JOIN HR_PERSONAL_INFO HPI ON HPI.PERSON_ID = HE.PERSON_ID WHERE HE.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND HE.PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT GET_AR_LEAVE_LENGTH( #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{fromTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), TO_DATE(#{toTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), #{leaveTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) APPLY_LENGTH, AR_GET_DAY_HOURS( #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{fromTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ) DAY_HOURS FROM DUAL
SELECT HPI.SEXCODE FROM HR_PERSONAL_INFO HPI WHERE HPI.PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT TO_CHAR(T.MIN_VALUE) MIN_VALUE, T.UNIT FROM AR_ITEM_PARAM T JOIN AR_ITEM AI ON AI.ITEM_NO = T.ITEM_NO JOIN HR_COMPANY CPNY ON CPNY.CPNY_ID = T.CPNY_ID WHERE T.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T.APPLY_TYPE = #{leaveTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T.APPLY_FLAG = '1' AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT TO_CHAR(EL.APPLY_NO) APPLY_NO, EL.PERSON_ID, TO_CHAR(EL.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM_DATE, TO_CHAR(EL.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'HH24:MI') FROM_TIME, TO_CHAR(EL.LEAVE_TO_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') TO_DATE, TO_CHAR(EL.LEAVE_TO_TIME, 'HH24:MI') TO_TIME, EL.AFFIRM_FLAG FROM ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_TB EL WHERE EL.APPLY_NO = #{applyNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EL.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND EL.ACTIVITY = '1'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AR_SHIFT_CHANGE (NO, PERSON_ID, CPNY_ID, DATE_STR, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, END_DATE_STR, CHANGE_TYPE) SELECT AR_SHIFT_CHANGE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, HR.PERSON_ID, HR.CPNY_ID, TO_CHAR(EL.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 0, SYSDATE, TO_CHAR(EL.LEAVE_TO_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), '考勤确认' FROM ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_TB EL, HR_EMPLOYEE HR WHERE EL.PERSON_ID = HR.PERSON_ID AND EL.ACTIVITY = '1' AND EL.APPLY_NO = #{applyNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
